# MeedyaDL 1.10.0-alpha.15

A large pre-release focused on **portability** (your settings, queue, history, and download index now travel between machines via a single `.meedyabundle` file), **a new Lyricsfile YAML format** for word-level synced lyrics that LRCGET can read, a **faster download index** that makes "do I already have this?" checks instant, and a **big memory-usage cleanup** that prevents long-running sessions from creeping up to multi-gigabyte RAM. Plus GAMDL 3.7.3 support, queue Pause/Resume, and a swath of housekeeping.

### What's new

- **Profile Bundle (`.meedyabundle`) — your whole MeedyaDL state in one file.** Settings → General now has an Export and Import button. Bundles travel settings, the queue, download history, your download index, the activity log, and download manifests between machines (or to back yourself up before reinstalling). Sensitive material — including your Apple Music cookies — is encrypted and password-protected; credentials need that password to import. On first launch the setup wizard scans Downloads / Desktop / home for `.meedyabundle` files and offers to restore from one so a re-install picks up where you left off. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/876))
- **Lyricsfile (`.lyrics`) YAML sidecars.** Settings → Lyrics → "Generate Lyricsfile (.lyrics)" emits the new open lyrics format jointly endorsed by [LRCGET 2.0](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrcget/releases/tag/2.0.0) and [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net/). It preserves Apple Music's word-level timing in a plain-text-editable YAML document that any text editor (and LRCGET itself) can read, and existing `.lyrics` files are never overwritten on re-download — so edits you make in LRCGET survive. Off by default; the format is officially experimental per upstream's own release notes. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/596))
- **Faster duplicate and gap detection.** MeedyaDL now keeps an internal index of what you've already downloaded, so smart-redownload detection, duplicate detection, and library-gap scans feel instant even on big libraries — no more waiting on "is this album already downloaded?" checks. On first launch after upgrading, MeedyaDL quietly builds this index from your existing download history and activity log, so nothing is lost. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/875))
- **Pause and Resume the queue without losing anything.** A new green Pause/Resume button sits alongside the destructive red Abort button on the Download and Queue pages. Pause leaves every queued and in-flight item exactly where it is; Resume picks them back up. Use this when you need the download bandwidth back for a video call or want to chain a few more URLs before kicking the queue off. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/889))
- **Library scan now detects codec-tier gaps from your manifest's plan.** When you scanned a folder previously, the "Re-download" button only fired if entire tracks were missing. Now it also detects when only certain codec variants are missing (e.g., you previously downloaded Atmos → ALAC but the ALAC files are gone) and re-fetches just those. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/766))
- **Library scan: retroactive duplicate cover art cleanup.** Folders downloaded before the cover art dedup fix (below) often ended up with two cover art files — GAMDL's default one and your configured one. Library Scan now spots and offers to remove the duplicate during a folder scan, so you don't have to clean them up by hand. This is a follow-up to the cover art fix below. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/892))
- **Wrapper LAN deployment guidance.** Settings → Advanced → Wrapper now shows a security hint when your wrapper URL points at anything other than `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`, and a new [docs page](docs/docker-wrapper-gamdl-guide-v2.md) covers running the wrapper on a separate machine on your LAN (e.g., a Raspberry Pi or Docker host) — including which ports to forward and why you shouldn't expose them to the open internet. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/891))
- **GAMDL 3.7.3 admitted to the support window.** Picks up an upstream reliability fix for unstreamable items — songs and music videos that used to crash outright no longer do; MeedyaDL now handles them the same way it already handles other unavailable content. Audio songs are unaffected. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/898))
- **Library URLs no longer log noisy errors.** When you queue a personal-library URL, MeedyaDL now correctly skips the extra metadata step that doesn't apply to library items, so the activity log stays clean. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/871))

### What's fixed

- **Long sessions could grow MeedyaDL's RAM to multiple gigabytes — fixed across four different areas.** A handful of internal buffers in the download pipeline, notifications, activity log, and per-download tracking weren't bounded; once you'd queued a long playlist or kept the app open for a few hours, RAM would climb without ever settling back down. All four are now capped, so long-running queues should hold steady around their normal memory use instead of growing without limit. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/897))
- **"Retry without Wrapper" pill is now actually visible** when a download fails because your wrapper is unreachable. Previously the pill blended into the activity log row and most users never saw it. Now it sits as a distinct amber action button next to the failed item. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/890))
- **More Apple Music song links are now accepted.** Some song links without extra context in the URL used to be rejected by MeedyaDL's link parser; they're now accepted just like the rest. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/888))
- **Duplicate cover art files are removed during the cover art rename step.** When your configured cover art file name already existed in the album folder, GAMDL's default cover art file would silently stick around as a duplicate. The rename step now removes the unused one instead. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/892))
- **Apple Music's "Media is not streamable" error now gets actionable guidance** instead of the generic "Check the Activity Log for more details." When content is region-locked, removed, or only present in your personal library, the activity log now explains what's wrong and what to try (a different storefront, or the catalog URL). This message used to get lost; now it reliably reaches you. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/898))
- **AcoustID and ReplayGain audio fingerprinting** now share the same underlying code across the whole MeedyaSuite app family instead of three separate local implementations. Functionally identical for you — same fingerprints, same tags — and it keeps working on ARM-based Linux systems (like a Raspberry Pi) without any extra tools to install. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/353))
- **Toggle switches in Settings** now announce their description text to screen readers reliably across VoiceOver, NVDA, and Orca. Previously some screen readers (notably Orca on Linux) only read the toggle label without the helper text underneath. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/125))
- **German and French translations were missing entire sections** — around 50 phrases each on the Download, Queue, Activity, and History pages. When you picked German or French, those pages silently fell back to English. Both languages are now complete, and a new check prevents this from happening again. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/111))

### Performance

- The first time you open MeedyaDL after upgrading, it builds your new download index from your existing history. Subsequent launches use that index directly — duplicate-detection and library-gap checks that used to comb through your whole history now feel instant. Most noticeable on libraries with more than 1,000 downloads. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/875))
- The memory fixes above cut peak RAM for typical long-running queues by an order of magnitude — even bursts of many notifications or a long activity log no longer scale memory use the way they used to. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/897))

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel; the Lyricsfile (`.lyrics`) format is itself experimental per [LRCGET's own release notes](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrcget/releases/tag/2.0.0) and the YAML schema may change in future versions. Enable the toggle if you want to try it; leave it off for stable workflows.
- Profile Bundle export/import is new and exhaustive — if you rely on a specific quirk of your current settings file format, please export once, inspect the bundle's contents, and confirm everything you expected is in there before relying on it for backup.
- Cross-suite portability: `.meedyabundle` files are designed to be read by future MeedyaSuite apps (MeedyaConverter, MeedyaManager) too. For now MeedyaDL is the only producer/consumer; when imports come from another producer the wizard surfaces a warning.
- GAMDL 3.7.2 changed music video tag emission to use uncensored track / album names where available. Songs are unaffected. If you have a music video filename template using `{title}` or `{album}`, resulting files after upgrading may have slightly different names than before; re-downloading the same music video after the upgrade will create a new file rather than skipping.
